steps.text: Add 1/3 cup cheddar cheese to a microwave-safe cup
Add 1 tablespoons of water to the bowl
Chop 1/4 red bell pepper into tiny bits
Place the chopped pepper in the microwave-safe bowl
Microwave the bowl, covered, for 2 minutes
Melt the cheese by microwaving cup for 30 sec. (Check after 30 seconds and microwave for 10 seconds more if needed)
Mix the cheese and red bell pepper in the bowl
add 1/2 tbsp softened butter to the bowl
Add 1/4 teaspoon salt to the bowl
Add 1/4 teaspoon pepper to the bowl
Mix all the ingredients of the bowl well
